instructions_to_main_agent: Upgrade Sanctuary.jsx with detailed materials, offerings (thali, garlands, sweets), dhunuchi incense smoke particles, rotating floor alpona mesh, and a stylized worshipper mesh.
Upgrade CursorMesh in Shell.jsx and Cursor.css with a tilted golden trishul SVG icon, smooth dot-mesh follow, and click flourish with spark particles and rotation thrust.
Add rotating alpona SVG accents in background sections with reduced-motion fallback.
Ensure all existing interactive functions (Enter/Exit, Hotspots [idol, craft, lamp], Lamp toggle, Flower offering, Reset, Expand) remain 100% operational.

Preserve all existing data-testid attributes (world-enter, hotspot-idol, hotspot-craft, hotspot-lamp, toggle-pandal-lights, offer-flowers, reset-sanctuary, enter-pandal, expand-sanctuary, discovery-popup, site-header, main-navigation, etc.).
Maintain English default with Bengali option toggle across all UI strings.
Ensure total responsive fidelity across mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
